display.name: API & Auth
display.description: Operational health of keeper-api. Request panels use normalized operation names rather than raw paths, preventing UUID/calendar-token fragmentation. Counts are attempts unless explicitly labeled distinct.

display.name: Request Completions
display.description: Completed keeper-api request/auth operations with a status code in the selected range.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'status_code')

display.name: HTTP 5xx Responses
display.description: Server-error responses. This is request count, not unique incidents.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND match(toString(toInt64(attributes_number['status_code'])), '^(5..)$')

display.name: Slowest Endpoint P95
display.description: Highest per-normalized-endpoint P95 across the selected range.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT max(p) AS value FROM (SELECT quantile(0.95)(attributes_number['duration_ms']) AS p FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'status_code') AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'duration_ms') GROUP BY JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name'))

display.name: Users Seeing 4xx / 5xx
display.description: Distinct identified users with an error response; anonymous/public failures are excluded.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT uniqExact(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND match(toString(toInt64(attributes_number['status_code'])), '^(4..|5..)$') AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') != ''

display.name: HTTP 4xx Responses
display.description: Client-visible 4xx responses; expected validation/404 responses are included.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND match(toString(toInt64(attributes_number['status_code'])), '^(4..)$')

display.name: API DB Timeout Failures
display.description: Structured API request failures containing the PostgreSQL connection-timeout signal.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND attributes_string['event_name'] = 'wide_event' AND match(body, 'ERR_POSTGRES_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT|Connection timeout after 30s')

display.name: Request Outcomes
display.description: All keeper-api request/auth completions, grouped by outcome.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'status_code') GROUP BY ts, outcome ORDER BY ts

display.name: Responses by Status Code
display.description: Response rate by actual status code. Use this to distinguish validation/client noise from server failures.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, toString(toInt64(attributes_number['status_code'])) AS status_code, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'status_code') GROUP BY ts, status_code ORDER BY ts

display.name: Top Normalized Endpoints
display.description: Request count by route template. Raw paths containing UUIDs or calendar identifiers are intentionally not used.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'status_code') GROUP BY operation_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 15

display.name: Error Responses by Endpoint
display.description: 4xx/5xx attempts grouped by normalized route template.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, toString(toInt64(attributes_number['status_code'])) AS status_code, count() AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND match(toString(toInt64(attributes_number['status_code'])), '^(4..|5..)$') GROUP BY operation_name, status_code ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 15

display.name: P95 Latency by Normalized Endpoint
display.description: Latency by route template; high-cardinality raw paths are excluded. Shows the 15 endpoints with the highest P95 over the selected range.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, quantile(0.95)(attributes_number['duration_ms']) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'status_code') AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'duration_ms') AND (JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name')) IN (SELECT JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'status_code') AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'duration_ms') GROUP BY JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') ORDER BY quantile(0.95)(attributes_number['duration_ms']) DESC LIMIT 15) GROUP BY ts, operation_name ORDER BY ts

display.name: P95 Authentication Middleware Duration
display.description: Time spent authenticating ordinary API requests, grouped by authentication method.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['auth'], 'method') AS auth_method, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractFloat(attributes_string['auth'], 'duration_ms')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['auth'], 'method') != '' AND JSONHas(attributes_string['auth'], 'duration_ms') GROUP BY ts, auth_method ORDER BY ts

display.name: Auth Endpoint Outcomes
display.description: Authentication-route completions, including session and passkey endpoints.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'type') = 'auth' GROUP BY ts, operation_name, outcome ORDER BY ts

display.name: Authenticated Requests by Method
display.description: Ordinary API requests that recorded an authentication method.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['auth'], 'method') AS auth_method, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['auth'], 'method') != '' GROUP BY ts, auth_method ORDER BY ts

display.name: WebSocket Lifecycle
display.description: Open/close events. These are lifecycle events, not a gauge of concurrently open sockets.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, count() / greatest(300, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'type') = 'connection' GROUP BY ts, operation_name ORDER BY ts

display.name: P95 Background-Job Duration
display.description: API-triggered OAuth imports and ICS source sync work; these can materially outlive the initiating request.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(900, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, if(startsWith(attributes_string['provider'], '{'), '', attributes_string['provider']) AS provider, quantile(0.95)(attributes_number['duration_ms']) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'type') = 'background-job' AND mapContains(attributes_number, 'duration_ms') GROUP BY ts, operation_name, provider ORDER BY ts

display.name: Background-Job Outcomes
display.description: Completion rate for API-owned background work.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), toIntervalSecond(greatest(900, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)))) AS ts, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS operation_name, if(startsWith(attributes_string['provider'], '{'), '', attributes_string['provider']) AS provider, attributes_string['outcome'] AS outcome, count() / greatest(900, intDiv({{.end_timestamp}} - {{.start_timestamp}}, 200)) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'type') = 'background-job' GROUP BY ts, operation_name, provider, outcome ORDER BY ts

display.name: Recent API Errors (Safe Summary)
display.description: Normalized route/status/slug summary. Raw tokenized paths and error stacks are intentionally omitted.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toString(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS time, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['operation'], 'name') AS op, toString(toInt64(attributes_number['status_code'])) AS status, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['error'], 'slug') AS slug, JSONExtractString(attributes_string['user'], 'id') AS user, toString(attributes_number['duration_ms']) AS duration_ms FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND resources_string['service.name'] = 'keeper-api' AND match(toString(toInt64(attributes_number['status_code'])), '^(4..|5..)$') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
